# forms

Types from PocketBase's Go package `forms`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [forms](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/forms).

## forms.AppleClientSecretCreate

AppleClientSecretCreate is a form struct to generate a new Apple Client Secret.

Reference: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/sign_in_with_apple/generate_and_validate_tokens

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | <code>string</code> | ClientId is the identifier of your app (aka. Service ID). |
| `teamId` | <code>string</code> | TeamId is a 10-character string associated with your developer account (usually could be found next to your name in the Apple Developer site). |
| `keyId` | <code>string</code> | KeyId is a 10-character key identifier generated for the "Sign in with Apple" private key associated with your developer account. |
| `privateKey` | <code>string</code> | PrivateKey is the private key associated to your app. Usually wrapped within -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- X -----END PRIVATE KEY-----. |
| `duration` | <code>number</code> | Duration specifies how long the generated JWT should be considered valid. The specified value must be in seconds and max 15777000 (~6months). |
| `validate()` | <code>(): void</code> | Validate makes the form validatable by implementing `validation.validatable` interface. |
| `submit()` | <code>(): string</code> | Submit validates the form and returns a new Apple Client Secret JWT. |

## forms.RecordUpsert

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `setContext()` | <code>(ctx: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/context#contextcontext">context.Context</a>): void</code> | SetContext assigns ctx as context of the current form. |
| `setApp()` | <code>(app: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase#coreapp">CoreApp</a>): void</code> | SetApp replaces the current form app instance. |
| `setRecord()` | <code>(record: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">core.Record</a>): void</code> | SetRecord replaces the current form record instance. |
| `resetAccess()` | <code>(): void</code> | ResetAccess resets the form access level to the accessLevelDefault. |
| `grantManagerAccess()` | <code>(): void</code> | GrantManagerAccess updates the form access level to "manager" allowing directly changing some system record fields (often used with auth collection records). |
| `grantSuperuserAccess()` | <code>(): void</code> | GrantSuperuserAccess updates the form access level to "superuser" allowing directly changing all system record fields, including those marked as "Hidden". |
| `hasManageAccess()` | <code>(): boolean</code> | HasManageAccess reports whether the form has "manager" or "superuser" level access. |
| `load()` | <code>(data: { [key: string]: any }): void</code> | Load loads the provided data into the form and the related record. |
| `drySubmit()` | <code>(callback: (txApp: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase#coreapp">CoreApp</a>, drySavedRecord: <a href="/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase/core/records#corerecord">core.Record</a>) =&gt; void): void</code> | Deprecated: It was previously used as part of the record create action but it is not needed anymore and will be removed in the future. |
| `submit()` | <code>(): void</code> | Submit validates the form specific validations and attempts to save the form record. |
